title: Mythos Task Intake
description: Contract for task-driven operational planning. Tracks a task from intake through similarity assessment, bounded planning, execution, and outcome delta capture.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task (slug or UUID)

task_summary.description: One-line summary of what the task accomplishes.

scope_type.description: Whether this task is system/framework/runtime work or client-scoped delivery work.

scope_justification.description: Why the chosen scope_type is correct for this task.

storage_root.description: Canonical storage directory for this task plan's artifacts. Must be _dev/reports/analysis/task-plans for system scope or clients/{client_code}/plans for client scope.

origin_client_code.description: Client code that originated the task, even if the task itself is system-scoped.

origin_project_id.description: Project that originated the task, even if the task itself is system-scoped.

description.description: The actual task description as stated by the operator or source

client_code.description: Client code if the task is client-scoped (e.g., CLIENTA, CLIENTB)

project_id.description: Project identifier if the task is project-scoped

requested_by.description: Who requested the task (operator name, signal ID, or Dart task ID)

similarity_assessment.description: Result of running assess-similarity.js against registered frameworks

top_framework.description: Framework ID of the best match

match_rationale.description: Why this framework was the top match

gaps.description: What the matched framework does not cover

applicable_modes.description: Execution modes compatible with this task

trust_tier.description: Trust classification based on match score

bounded_plan.description: Operational plan mapping task steps to framework steps where possible

framework_step.description: Corresponding framework prompt chain step, null if gap

stage.description: Optional human-facing phase/stage label for audience-adaptive rendering and plan diagrams.

stage_title.description: Optional human-facing title for this stage when stage is a terse identifier.

domain.description: Optional explicit domain for audience-adaptive rendering. If absent, renderers may derive it from framework_step.

depends_on.description: Optional list of step_id values this step depends on. Additive; absent means sequence order is authoritative.

audiences.description: Optional pre-authored per-audience What/Why voicings. Renderers must treat missing entries as visible needs-authoring/fallback states, not silent omission.

what.description: Audience-specific what-this-step-does phrasing. Transitional flat strings are accepted; nested objects carry the full provenance contract.

why.description: Audience-specific why-this-step-matters phrasing. Transitional flat strings are accepted; nested objects carry the full provenance contract.

what_provenance.description: Transitional flat-shape source/provenance handle for the what field.

why_provenance.description: Transitional flat-shape source/provenance handle for the why field.

source.description: Optional source label such as authored, enriched, or derived.

is_gap.description: True if this step has no framework coverage

required_gates.description: Gates from the matched framework's guardrails

risk_notes.description: Known risks or cautions for this plan

hardening_opportunity.description: If this task succeeds, what framework hardening could it enable

produced_by_actor_id.description: Actor ID that produced this plan

produced_by_harness_id.description: Harness ID of the producing actor

validated_by_actor_id.description: Actor ID that validated this plan for acceptance

validated_by_harness_id.description: Harness ID of the validating actor

validation_artifact.description: Path to the durable validation artifact

routing_expectations.description: Explicit execution-closeout routing expectations for run-plan after bounded task execution

risk_tier.description: Overall execution risk tier for post-execution review routing

review_lane.description: Expected post-execution review lane for run-plan closeout

review_lane_rationale.description: Why this review lane is the expected closeout path

escalation_triggers.description: Conditions that should force escalation above the expected lane

outcome_delta.description: Post-execution comparison of plan vs actual results

divergences.description: Where execution diverged from the plan

should_harden_framework.description: Whether the outcome suggests the framework should be hardened

hardening_notes.description: Specific hardening recommendations based on outcome

completion_evidence.description: Durable evidence for all four completion criteria. Completion requires all four to be true.

all_steps_done.description: Whether all plan steps have been executed

operator_acceptance_received.description: Whether operator acceptance has been recorded

produced_by_actor_id.description: Actor ID that produced this outcome

produced_by_harness_id.description: Harness ID of the producing actor

validated_by_actor_id.description: Actor ID that validated this outcome for acceptance

validated_by_harness_id.description: Harness ID of the validating actor
